title: Reproduce and identify deferred cancellation heartbeat loss
goal: Create a controlled failing regression and identify event-loop, heartbeat or admission evidence before choosing a causal fix
acceptance: A committed deterministic regression explains the observed worker connection loss
Distinguish fixture timing sensitivity from production behavior
Preserve cancellation replay and fail-closed resource ownership
privacy: Neutral repository fixtures only; no model inference, private hosts or device operations
validation: Independent review before a causal fix closes the parent
escalation: Do not merely widen timeouts or weaken assertions
Keep uncertain external effects held until reconciled

effort.basis: Estimate added at featurePlans adoption (2026-11-11): controlled reproduction of the deferred-cancellation heartbeat loss, then classification; estimate, not a measurement. Baseline 2 days (baselineDays, history), re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0) as 1.25 h (judged rate of about 1.5 agent hours per former focused day, informed by NERV merge history). Revisions 2026-11-11 and 2026-11-12 (dated in git history and the archived B-046 record): Windows failures after the first fix, the owner's agreement to continue past the estimate, fixes in #276, #278 and #279, mechanism (3) identified in #280, remedy (a) implemented in #293; about 5.75 h spent by then. Re-estimated 2026-11-12 at 0.6x from `work-items calibrate`: 0.5 h for review and CI, kept. Closed 2026-11-12: remedy (a) merged in #293 after a fresh-context review; the 11 following CI runs passed every B-046 and F-014 deferred-approval test on Windows and Linux coverage. About 0.5 h more for CI evidence and the closing records: 6.25 h agent spent (stated) against a 1.25 h baseline.
